## Training

Independent SAP S/4HANA training for corporate teams and training providers. MM / procurement is the focus. SD topics and FI integration are described in the current corporate CV; specific course delivery is agreed individually. A course code is not a promise of availability. Five-day descriptions must not be equated with a complete official SAP academy.

## Course-code context

S4525 is a documented SAP course code for consumption-based planning and forecasting. SAP also publishes S45250, course version 29, titled Exploring Consumption-Based Planning and Forecasting in SAP S/4HANA. These references do not establish which version Mario currently offers. See the [official S45250 course outline](https://cdn.training.sap.com/cdn/course-pdf/S45250_EN_Col29_CO_A4.pdf/G/EN/S45250/029).

## Technical article scope

Published topics: account determination, special stocks and invoice verification. K is vendor consignment, E sales order stock and Q project stock. Q is not an additional reservation variant or a synonym for quality inspection. Articles identify their documentation scope and sources; no SAP system test is claimed.
